notes: MultiVault keeps its own logic small and delegatecalls the MultiVaultLib library for creation, deposits and redemptions; the text shows these wrappers with their re-encoded array arguments (4 P2 lines: the encoded arrays of createAtoms / depositBatch / redeemBatch / createTriples), the pause and re-entrance checks (stor9B77 == 2), and the _msgValue choice from transient storage ('if uint8(transient[0]): transient[1] else call.value'), all correct. All 106 functions were reviewed; the getters and setters in full. Source loops in this bytecode: MultiVault.sol:577 and :588 (multicall, both shown as while; the second delegatecalls data[i] with the value in transient[1]). The other loops of the pack (MultiVaultLib._createAtoms :562, _createTriples :691, _emitAtomContexts :583, _validateAtomUris :598/:602, _validatePayment :1433, depositBatch :300, redeemBatch :352, StringsUpgradeable.toString :28) belong to the external library. Implicit whiles: calldata array decodes and re-encodes for the library calls (1045, 1084, 1097, 1227, 1266, 1279, 1351, 1364, ...), the results zeroing (1138, rotated: P3) and the bytes[] result encode (1182). summary: A clean, faithful text of a thin vault that delegatecalls its library; its only loops (multicall) are shown well, with a few implied bound checks kept.
